args.title: Fix parseStatement to skip all trailing blank lines, not just one
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement currently pops only a single trailing empty string from `lines`, which handles the final newline artifact but leaves a genuine blank line before EOF in place, causing it to fail assertShape as a malformed short row. Update the logic to skip or trim all trailing blank lines (e.g. loop while the last line is empty, or filter blank lines before parsing) instead of popping just one.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseStatement only pops a single trailing empty string (the terminating-newline artifact), so a genuine blank line before EOF remains in `lines` and fails assertShape as a malformed short row. The fix should skip or trim all trailing blank lines instead of popping just one.
